premises.text: Antimicrobial resistance from antibiotic overuse is a major health threat motivating alternatives
premises.evidence_span: antimicrobial resistance is a top 10 global health threat in the world facing humanity

premises.text: Precision phage platform uses whole genome sequencing, robotics, automation, and ML/AI
premises.evidence_span: precision phage platform leveraging testing using whole genome sequencing, robotics, automation, and big data machine learning and AI

premises.text: Phages kill target bacteria precisely without wiping out good bacteria, unlike broad antibiotics
premises.evidence_span: precise assassins that kill the bad bacteria, but leave the good bacteria alone

premises.text: Single phage serum only works when the patient's overgrowth matches the target (e.g., C. acnes); other cohorts need different solutions
premises.evidence_span: it worked incredibly well for a certain cohort of people

premises.text: Multi-site swab kit plus WGS and quantitative algorithm deliver microbiome type, resistance genes visibility, and personalized phage serum
premises.evidence_span: Unlike others that use 16S technology, we use a more advanced technology called whole genome sequencing

premises.text: Eight skin microbiome types with matching formulations scaled via biobanks, screening, and high-titer bioreactors
premises.evidence_span: We produce phages by leveraging our biobanks of over 10,000 bacterial phage and fungal strains

value.text: Precision phage-based skin solutions matched to the patient's microbiome to reduce antibiotic dependence
value.evidence_span: get people off of Accutane and antibiotics

secondary_value.text: Broader human-health phage platform beyond skin
secondary_value.evidence_span: platform that is applicable to many areas of human health

Skin Microbiome Discovery Kit and custom phage serums
